audi-klubs.title: Audi Klubs
audi-klubs.description: A real club platform with a WordPress-style content editor — the client updates pages, news and events themselves.
audi-klubs.longDescription: Audi Klubs is a full club platform: homepage, events, shop, gallery, classifieds and donations. The key client value is a WordPress-style admin (Filament CMS). They can edit page content, hero slides, partners, FAQ and shop without code. Open a page in admin, edit sections, publish — exactly what clients want: a strong site plus self-serve control.

sturisi-vib.title: Stūrīši VIB
sturisi-vib.description: Live website for an earthworks and landscaping company — sturisivib.lv.
sturisi-vib.longDescription: Stūrīši VIB specializes in landscaping, drainage and earthworks. The site clearly presents site preparation, road building, paving, melioration and greening. Clean design, mobile-ready layout and a contact form — so customers find the service and get in touch fast.

kozy-eats.title: Kozy Eats
kozy-eats.description: Mock project — a warm cafe landing page with menu and order CTA.
kozy-eats.longDescription: A demo cafe brand site: clear hero, menu focus and an order button. An example of a simple conversion-focused website.

favela-nightclub.title: Favela Nightclub
favela-nightclub.description: Mock project — a dark nightclub site with events and ticket CTA.
favela-nightclub.longDescription: A demo nightclub brand site: strong visual style, event listing and a clear tickets button. An example of an atmospheric brand website.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.subtitle: Practical answers before we start.
faq.pageDescription: How much does a website cost in Latvia? How long does it take? Do you also build apps?

0.q: How much does website development cost in Latvia?
0.a: A simple website starts from €200. An online store, mobile app or larger system — from €2000. We’ll give an exact price after a short talk — free of charge.

1.q: Do you do more than websites?
1.a: Specialised CRM systems for companies, mobile apps, online stores, redesigns, SEO audits and any programming. If a business needs something digital — we can make it happen.

2.q: How long does a website take?
2.a: A typical website — 1 to 3 weeks. Redesigns are often faster. Apps and larger projects — 4 to 12 weeks. We agree on the timeline before we start.

3.a: We check your site — speed, titles and Google visibility. Then you get a clear fix list, and we can implement the fixes too.

4.a: Yes. We build iOS and Android apps, plus web apps. Tell us what you need — we’ll give a price and timeline.

5.q: Where in Latvia do you work?
5.a: Across Latvia — in Riga and remotely. We work online, so location isn’t a blocker.
